# Riprap

> Event-scoped mutual protection pools on Solana. One pool, one narrowly defined peril, one finite event. Peer jurors adjudicate claims, unused funds return to members pro-rata, the pool dissolves. Pre-launch.

Riprap is a platform for micro mutuals: attendees of an event pay a fixed entry fee into one pool against one narrowly defined peril. A qualifying incident during the event is adjudicated by jurors drawn from the pool's own staked members (adjudication runs on Accord, a Schelling-point arbitration protocol; voting coherently with the honest majority is the profitable strategy). Approved claims pay out of the pool; payouts are capped twice, by the member's tier and by the pool's balance. When the claims window closes, every unused cent returns to members pro-rata and the pool dissolves permanently. No insurer, no reserve, no retained profit.

Money leaves a pool through exactly two governed doors: spending (adjudicated claims) and liquidation. There is no third exit and no discretionary signer.

## Pages

- [Platform landing](https://riprap.xyz/): what a peer-to-peer risk pool is, the five-step lifecycle, ten honest FAQ answers, waitlist. The peril never appears on this page.
- [Blade Pool @ Breakpoint 2026](https://riprap.xyz/#/2026-breakpoint-blade-pool): the first pool — policy fineprint, tiers, coverage window. Hash route: renders client-side from the landing document.
- [App](https://riprap.xyz/#/app): the member wallet surface — join and claims, reading on-chain pool state. Hash route: renders client-side from the landing document.

## Policy: Blade Pool @ Breakpoint 2026 (the first pool)

- Peril: knife assault — bodily injury caused by another person intentionally using a knife or other sharp-edged/bladed instrument against the member.
- Coverage window: 15–17 November 2026 — opens with the conference, closes with the conference (daily hours per the published event schedule).
- Covered area: Olympia Convention Centre and designated event area, London.
- Tiers: Basic $10 entry, max payout $1,000 · Standard $20 entry, max payout $2,000 · Premium $40 entry, max payout $4,000. The max payout is the total a member can receive for qualifying claims from the covered event.
- Exclusions (not covered): injuries caused by the member themselves; accidental injuries involving a knife or blade; ordinary handling or use of a knife; consensual activities; incidents outside the coverage period; incidents outside the covered area; emotional distress without qualifying bodily injury; claims exceeding the member's tier maximum.
- Claims: a member files a claim with evidence for a qualifying incident during the window; jurors drawn from this pool's staked members adjudicate it. If approved claims exceed the funds in the pool, payouts are reduced proportionally — the mutual never pays more than it holds.
- End: after the conference, the claims submission period, and settlement of approved claims, the remaining pool balance is distributed to members and the mutual dissolves permanently. No funds remain.

## Status and links

- Status: pre-launch. No pool has run, no members exist, no payouts to show. The first pool is the build target, not a track record.
- X: https://x.com/riprapxyz
